clips.send: A parent who just installed a whole-house filter sends this to the friend who still orders tap water at restaurants - the anxiety of missing an obvious source, from the coffee to the ice.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says putting chlorine in city water is genuinely smart - it clears out the bacteria, viruses and parasites that would otherwise make tap water dangerous.

His point is what comes after: you still don't want to drink that chlorine yourself. Soup, tea, coffee, even jarred spaghetti sauce from the store - if it started as tap water, the chlorine rides along no matter what color it turns.

So at a restaurant, his rule is simple: bottled or spring water, no ice, since most ice machines run off the same municipal line.

What's the last drink you didn't think to check?
